verdict.rationale: The docs confirm a dedicated pricing page exists and describe part of the billing model (only unique ingested content is billed, with a 100% cache discount, plus connector inclusion), but no evidence shows an explicit free tier or concrete per-unit rate figures that would let a platform engineer project costs. missing for 10: explicit free-tier terms, per-unit/usage rate table or dollar figures, and any independent corroboration of actual pricing numbers.
